value.rationale: The primary source reports many inequivalent codes at the new \([23,4,14]\) parameter set, so invariants finer than \([n,k,d]\) are directly useful for comparison. For a projective dimension-four code, the weight enumerator is the complete hyperplane spectrum; the line spectrum probes lower-dimensional incidence and the stabilizer measures symmetry. Together these form a natural reusable structural fingerprint of the displayed optimal representative.
